<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in server/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Full mode (default) runs all components in a single process: the HTTP server, the listener/resolver for certificate signatures, and the signer. This is suitable for single-instance deployments.

## Synopsis

```
ssoosshd serve full [flags] [args]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoosshd`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoosshd config file |
